response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and notable geospatial contributions via GISCollective, but lacks direct C++/Rust experience in production routing or geospatial data pipelines, and his recent work is heavily focused on TypeScript/Node.js and AI-agent tooling, which raises concerns about his readiness for the core C++-centric routing tile responsibilities.
strengths: Proven geospatial project experience with GISCollective and Open Green Map
Demonstrated ability to work across diverse tech stacks and learn new languages
Strong open-source contributions and community engagement in data tooling
concerns: No evidence of commercial C++ or Rust development in routing or navigation systems
Recent roles emphasize TypeScript/Node.js, not low-latency systems or geospatial data pipelines
Lacks explicit experience with distributed systems, fault tolerance, or routing tile optimization
